style: Readable side-view 2D dark cyberpunk game art, steel silhouettes, crimson and cyan accents; no green subject details because green is reserved for chroma key.

assets.description: A fragile metallic bird with angular steel feathers, a small crimson eye, silver body and red wing highlights, facing right in strict side view
assets.prompt: Locked-off orthographic 2D sprite animation using exactly the profile and framing of Picture 1. The bird body, head, beak and tail hold the same right-facing profile and fixed center. Only the near wing gently pivots up and down around its shoulder hinge in a small steady flapping cycle. Flat clean steel-gray and crimson shapes with a dark outline. Pure green #00FF00 background. Return to the starting pose at the end.
assets.reference_prompt: A flat orthographic 2D game sprite of {desc}. Exact right-facing profile with one red eye visible, beak pointing horizontally right, compact folded tail and one visible near wing half-open at the shoulder. Small clean simple silhouette, flat silver and crimson color shapes with a dark outline. The bird body is horizontal. Centered in a pure green #00FF00 square, occupying the middle half of the image with broad empty margins. Fixed side camera.
assets.identity: same metallic bird, steel feathers, red eye and wing accents, side view facing right
assets.requirements: The bird visibly flaps its wings while its body remains centered. Silhouette and details remain coherent. It must not walk, turn to face the viewer or translate across the image.

assets.description: One tall vertical industrial steel hazard column with dark ribbed metal casing, red warning bands and a cyan-lit flat end cap, viewed from the side
assets.prompt: Locked-off static product shot of one isolated tall vertical industrial hazard column. Whole object including both ends visible with generous margins. Flat pure green #00FF00 background. No floor, shadows, letters, people or extra objects. The column and camera stay completely still.
assets.requirements: Exactly one vertical solid metal column, clearly readable silhouette, complete object in frame, no detached floating pieces. Suitable as a scrolling hazard sprite.

assets.description: Distant ruined industrial skyline beneath a crimson sky, with dark factories, thin smog layers and faint cyan lights
assets.prompt: Locked-off wide side-view 2D dark cyberpunk game background: distant ruined factories in the lower third beneath a crimson sky, faint cyan lights, atmospheric smog. Large quiet dark open air in the central and upper frame so a foreground flying bird and hazards remain readable. No foreground pipes, characters, HUD, text or camera motion. Static scene.
assets.requirements: Wide coherent industrial background under a crimson sky. Central flight corridor stays uncluttered and readable. No foreground actors, pipes, text or UI. No ground platform requirement; this is a flying game.
